app.name: Decathlon Online Shopping App
app.description: India's leading sports retailer app offering equipment, apparel, and accessories for over 70 sports with in-store and online shopping features.

verdict.one_liner: Decathlon India collects standard shopping data but tracks your location even when the app is closed, shares data with affiliates, and may transfer it in a merger or acquisition.
verdict.summary: Decathlon India's privacy policy reveals broad data sharing practices and aggressive location tracking. The app collects your personal details for orders, tracks your device location in the background for personalized offers, and uses Google and Facebook remarketing to follow you across the web. Data is shared with corporate affiliates and may be transferred to a new owner if Decathlon is acquired. The policy does not explicitly promise never to sell your data.
verdict.recommendation_reason: If you are concerned about background location tracking, broad data sharing with affiliates, and the possibility of your data being transferred in a corporate sale, consider whether the sports gear convenience is worth the privacy trade-off.

red.title: Tracks location when app is closed
red.plain_english: Decathlon may access your device location even when the app is closed to send personalized offers and enhance your shopping experience.

red.title: Google and Facebook remarketing
red.plain_english: Decathlon uses Google AdWords and Facebook remarketing to advertise to you on third-party websites based on your past visits to their site.

red.title: Shares data with affiliates and may transfer in acquisition
red.plain_english: Decathlon shares your personal information with its corporate entities and affiliates, and may transfer all of it to another business if Decathlon is ever merged or acquired.

red.title: Google Analytics with advertising demographics
red.plain_english: Decathlon uses Google Analytics with Demographics and Interest Reporting, which combines your browsing data with Google's advertising profile about you.

green.title: Does not ask for OTP or CVV
green.plain_english: Decathlon explicitly states it does not ask for your net banking OTP, debit/credit card CVV, banking passwords, or UPI IDs.

green.title: Self-service account deletion available
green.plain_english: You can request deletion of your personal data and account through the Account -> My Profile section in the app or website.

green.title: Can opt out of marketing communications
green.plain_english: You can opt out of receiving marketing and promotional messages from Decathlon and its affiliates at any time.

green.title: Claims physical and technological security
green.plain_english: Decathlon states it stores and processes data on computers protected by physical and reasonable technological security measures per the Indian IT Act 2000.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Decathlon shares your data with its corporate entities and affiliates, and may transfer all of your personal information to another business if Decathlon merges with or is acquired by another company.
categories.detail: Data is shared with corporate entities and affiliates who may market to you unless you opt out. Third-party disclosure occurs for legal compliance, fraud prevention, and marketing activities. In a merger or acquisition, all personal information may be transferred to the new entity.

These entities and affiliates may market to the Buyers as a result of such sharing unless the Buyers explicitly opt-out... Decathlon and Decathlon's affiliates will share / transfer some or all of Buyer's personal information with another business entity should Decathlon (or Decathlon's assets) plan to merge with, or be acquired by that business entity, or re-organization, amalgamation, restructuring of business.

All data may be transferred in merger/acquisition
Third-party disclosure for marketing and legal purposes

Third-party vendors, including Google & Facebook, use cookies to serve ads based on someone's past visits to the Decathlon.in website... categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request deletion of your personal data through the Account -> My Profile section in the app or website, or by contacting Decathlon at care.india@decathlon.com or 7676798989.
categories.detail: Users have a 'right to erasure' and can delete their account and data via self-service in the app or by contacting customer care.
categories.policy_excerpt: If the customer wishes to exercise their right to erasure and have their personal data or account permanently removed from our records, they may do so under the 'Account->My Profile' section in the app or Website or contact us at care.india@decathlon.com or phone number 7676798989
concerns: Deletion process not fully automated

categories.label: Policy Change Notification

categories.detail: No explicit mention of policy change notification procedures or consent requirements for material changes.
concerns: No explicit policy change notification process mentioned
